name: Ojou-sama no Inu! ~Boku no Subete wa Kimi no Mono?~
original_name: お嬢様のいぬっ! ～僕の全ては君のモノ?～
source:
Hitoshi Feburary is the son and successor of a noble family.
However, the current head of the family has too many wasteful habits, and his father is now on the verge of bankrupcy.
Now with no place to live, Hitoshi wanders the roads in despair, and he has no choice but to listen to those words in his fathers will: "Seek out the Grape residence."
Greeting him upon his arrival are "Karen", the mistress of the house, and "Jasmin", the maid.
At first, Karen seemed to be a graceful girl, but when Hitoshi accidentally snaps at her, she boils over and her personality changes drastically.
After that, Hiroshi ends up serving as her butler, or perhaps he's more like a maid.
His everyday life now consists of having to fulfill Karen's every selfish request...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033081.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
仁．費布拉里是一戶貴族家庭的兒子兼繼承人。
然而，現任家主揮霍無度，父親如今已經瀕臨破產。
仁無家可歸，絕望地遊蕩街頭，只能聽從父親遺囑中的那句話：「去尋找格雷普宅邸。」
抵達後迎接他的，是宅邸女主人卡蓮與女僕茉莉。
卡蓮起初看起來優雅端莊，可仁不慎頂撞她後，她頓時勃然大怒，彷彿變了個人。
此後，仁成了她的管家，或者說更像一名女僕。
如今，他的日常就是滿足卡蓮每一個任性的要求……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033081.html]DLsite English[/url]]
